subject: Heterogeneous number of secondary occasions in UMF

messages.author: 1827609f87fbbb92
messages.subject: Heterogeneous number of secondary occasions in UMF
parts:
Hello,

I have a dataset with different number of secondary occasions for each primary occasions and i have to run some colext models. How can i insert this information in the unmarkedMultiFrame object? 

Thank you in advance

Fabiola

messages.author: 00ebeb6e0521112d
messages.subject: RE: [unmarked] Heterogeneous number of secondary occasions in UMF
parts:
Dear Fabiola,

you simply make a data set with the same number of 2ry occasions everywhere and "fill in" the "missing" data with missing values (NAs). For unmarked, the data sets must always be balanced (i.e., same sample size everywhere) and if you don't have balance, you have to make it by filling up with NAs.

Kind regards  --- Marc
